levels.surface: أبومحمد الحسن بن عبد الله الرازي

notes: «1-108» is the report number; «سيدي» and the honorifics are left out.
«حدثني أبي» with no name is a relation link; «أبي» plus a name (rule 7) is one link carrying the name alone.
The Imams here are in the chain after «حدثني», so they are narrators; the Prophet's words close the chain.
